chosen_option: Charge Chaplain on Bike (8.5" away, 28% chance)
note: [LLM critic, medium conf] Delta declares a 28% charge on a 1-wound Chaplain. The score is positive only because ch_damage, ch_can_wipe, ch_can_halve and other bonuses add up to far more than the chance penalty, so the unit may be pulled off the objective for little gain. Fix: Cap expected damage at target remaining wounds. Multiply the total charge value by success probability instead of adding a flat chance penalty. Add a cost for leaving a held objective and for ending the charge far from support. Apply the same cap to the can_wipe, can_halve and tie_up_shooter bonuses.
